sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Tulika Bibidh Rang writes Hindi poetry alongside work in communication education. Amity University’s faculty profile identifies her with its School of Communication in Madhya Pradesh and records interests in traditional media, audiovisual storytelling and folk art. The same profile records a 2021 Pen In Books Young Author Award for her Hindi poetry manuscript “Gulabi Canvas”.

In “Basanti Budget”, the language of examinations, meetings, growth and financial planning is redirected towards emotional life. Against an exhausting race for achievement, the poem proposes making room for family laughter, neighbourly food, affection and hope. Spring becomes a model of change that is generous rather than merely competitive; the budget worth balancing is one that leaves space for shared happiness.
